premise: The last dragon rider, bonded to the only dragon still alive.

bible.title: The Last Flight
bible.era: A medieval world of swords, stone keeps, and messenger birds.

extraordinary.reach: Colossal beasts capable of flight and elemental breath, now reduced to a single survivor.
A sacred psychic link that unites the minds of a human and a dragon.
Ancient magic tied to the earth, now nearly forgotten by humanity.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: A fractured feudal society that has largely forgotten the age of magic and dragons.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.description: A massive, scaled beast of ancient power, capable of devastating breath attacks and majestic flight.
creatures.habitat: High mountain peaks and ancient ruins

nature: Magic flows through underground leylines, pooling in ancient ruins where nature grows strangely vibrant.

travel.description: Travel is slow, relying on horses, carriages, and sailing ships. News is carried by riders or carrier pigeons.

medicine.healing: Traditional herbalism and rare, minor healing magic close to leylines.

laws.text: The harboring, harboring of parts, or worship of dragons is strictly forbidden by imperial decree.

rules.text: A bonded dragon and rider share thoughts, emotions, and sensory perceptions across vast distances.
If a bonded dragon or rider dies, the survivor's spirit is permanently and severely scarred.
The magic sustaining dragons is tied to ancient sanctuaries, and staying away from them weakens their breath.
Elemental magic: real, and hidden from most people.

mysteries.question: What truly caused the sudden extinction of the other dragons a century ago?
mysteries.answer: An engineered alchemical blight, created by the Empire's founders to break the power of the old dragon riders.
clues: An ancient, sealed laboratory hidden beneath Ironhold Keep.
Symptoms of a strange, black-veined corruption described in old texts.
Vesper's lingering fear of certain ancient imperial metal relics.

player.name: Kaelen
player.description: A young rider bearing the quiet weight of an extinct order, carrying a sharp gaze and a calm presence.
player.appearance: Slender but athletic build, weather-beaten leather riding clothes, wind-tousled dark hair, and hands calloused from reins.

skills.name: Dragon Riding
skills.notes: Guiding a massive beast through turbulent winds and high-altitude combat.

skills.name: Survival
skills.notes: Finding food, shelter, and staying hidden in the wilderness.

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.notes: Basic defense with a rider's blade.

traits.name: Dragon Bonded
traits.description: Your soul is tethered to Vesper. You feel her pain, hear her thoughts, and can share her senses.

powers.name: Mind Share
powers.description: Communicate silently with Vesper and share her sight and hearing from afar.
limits: Prolonged sensory sharing causes a mild headache.

fears: being captured alive by the Vanguard

items.name: Ancient Rider's Blade
items.description: A sword forged from lightweight, sky-tempered steel, bearing the faded crest of the Dragon Riders.

items.name: Reinforced Leather Saddle
items.description: A heavy leather saddle designed to lock a rider safely onto a dragon's back during flight.

connections.name: Vesper
connections.note: Your bonded dragon companion, closer to you than any human.

vesper.name: Vesper
vesper.description: The last living dragon. Her scales are the color of twilight, and her eyes hold the weight of a dying race.
vesper.appearance: A slender yet massive dragon with iridescent purple-black scales, scarred wings, and deep golden eyes.

commander-garrick.name: Commander Garrick
commander-garrick.description: The ruthless leader of the local Iron Vanguard detachment, obsessed with earning imperial favor.
commander-garrick.appearance: A scarred veteran in polished iron plate armor, with short graying hair and cold grey eyes.

wants: To present the head of the last dragon to the Emperor.

agenda.goal: Track down the dragon's lair using scout reports.
agenda.method: Sending hunting parties into the northern peaks.

iron-vanguard.name: The Iron Vanguard
iron-vanguard.description: A militaristic order dedicated to purging the world of the last remnants of magic and ancient beasts.
iron-vanguard.goal: Locate and destroy the last surviving dragon to secure imperial dominance.
iron-vanguard.methods: Scouring the wilderness, interrogating locals, and burning magical ruins.
iron-vanguard.strength: A disciplined army equipped with heavy armor, siege weapons, and ballistas designed to bring down massive beasts.

dragons-roost.name: Dragon's Roost
dragons-roost.description: A ruined, wind-swept sanctuary hidden high among the razor-sharp cliffs of the northern peaks.

whispering-woods.name: The Whispering Woods
whispering-woods.description: An ancient, dense forest stretching across the valley floor, shrouded in mist.

ironhold-keep.name: Ironhold Keep
ironhold-keep.description: The grim, dark stone fortress that serves as the regional seat of the Iron Vanguard.

fact-1.text: You are the last human who knows how to ride a dragon.

fact-2.text: Vesper is the absolute last of her kind.

fact-3.text: The Iron Vanguard will execute anyone found helping a dragon.

the-last-flight.title: The Last Flight
the-last-flight.stakes: The survival of the dragon race and your own life.

vanguard-search.name: The Vanguard's Hunt
steps: Scouts report strange shadows over the Whispering Woods.
Iron Vanguard patrols begin blocking the mountain passes.
A Vanguard hunting party locates the path to Dragon's Roost.
Commander Garrick leads an assault force to slay the dragon.

event-1.title: The Vanguard's Hunt: Scouts report strange shadows over the Whispering Woods.

positions: Kaelen stands at the edge of the roost facing Vesper.
Vesper lies coiled on the ruined flagstones.
scene.ended_on: Vesper shifts her massive wings, her golden eyes watching you in silent expectation.

state.summary: You are the last dragon rider, bound by mind and soul to Vesper, the last surviving dragon. High in the mountains, you must keep her hidden from the ruthless Iron Vanguard who seek to end your kind forever.

scenes.narration: The wind howling across the razor-sharp crags of Dragon's Roost carries the chill of eternal snows. You stand at the edge of the ruined stone sanctuary, your leather riding clothes whipping against your legs as you gaze into the warm, golden eyes of Vesper. Her massive, twilight-colored form lies coiled on the cracked flagstones, her iridescent scales catching the early morning light like oil on water. Through the sacred mind-share of your bond, her silent thoughts drift into yours—a heavy, protective warmth tinged with the ancient sorrow of her dying race. Down in the valleys, the Iron Vanguard's scouts are hunting, their imperial ban drawing closer to this final peak with every passing day. Vesper lets out a low, rumbling breath that warms the freezing air, shifting her scarred wings as if urging you to make a choice before the smoke of the Vanguard's campfires rises too high above the tree line. The vast sky lies open before you, beautiful and treacherous.

choices: Reach out and touch Vesper's scales to deepen your mind-share connection.
Check your leather saddle and gather your survival gear for departure.
Look down into the valleys below to search for Vanguard patrols.
